gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hind-guntur: Wiry and wide-spaced: Bushcraft keeps every curve one thickness, capitals barely rising above lowercase. And Hind Guntur, with open curves and stamped-metal forms, lets pages run along without tugging at the eye.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hind-madurai: Bushcraft is wide-spaced, closed and uniform in stroke, capitals barely standing out. Hind Madurai brings s curves open at both ends and lowercase that fills the line, a sans-serif partner for the closed heading.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara keeps a clean, constant thickness and spacious gaps in rounded glyphs. Bushcraft is at its best expressive and widely spaced, while Hind Vadodara is at its best open and professional.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-karla: Uniform curves with no weight shift and capitals that barely stand out make Bushcraft feel artistic. Karla brings a gaping c and a stocky middle band, and closed against open is what makes this pairing work.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-khula: Bushcraft is closed, wide-spaced and uniform in thickness. Khula, a sans with a brush-pen belly and curves holding their mouths open, supplies the best part: closed letters meeting open ones.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-krub: Krub feels contemporary and unfussy, its curves stopping before the loop closes and its x-height pronounced. Bushcraft's closed, expressive letters make that openness stand out, the pairing's real strength.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-kufam: Bushcraft is expressive and artistic, its capitals barely above the lowercase and its letters spaced extra wide. Kufam counters with a single neon-tube track width and generously open e curves, bodies dominating the line.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-mada: Expressive is the right word for Bushcraft, whose curves keep their width through every turn, while Mada's curves refuse to close. That mix of constant lines and open ones is the best thing here.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-martel-sans: Pen-plotter smoothness defines Bushcraft, with no weight shift along any curve and extra-wide spacing. And it earns its keep big and brief, with Martel Sans offering generous openings in every curve below.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-montserrat-under: Wide-set and artistic: Bushcraft shows no weight shift anywhere, capitals barely above lowercase. Montserrat Underline does the opposite, with breathing counters and round bowls whose walls never swell, as a sans-serif body.
